_comment: Tietokoneet (games/robotti, omenalinja): generated by tools/tietokoneet/gen-voice.ts, same ids as voice/fi.json.

clips.tk_r_askeleet: The robot's battery is empty. Make it a program: press the arrows, then start with the green button.
clips.tk_r_toista: The robot has only a few boxes. Press the same arrow many times and the box gets a number. The robot repeats the step that many times.
clips.tk_r_jos: The robot walks by itself. When it steps on a coloured square, it turns. Choose an arrow for each colour.
clips.tk_r_tormasi: Oops, the robot crashed! The red box is a bug, a mistake. Fix it.
clips.tk_r_tormasi_jos: Oops, the robot crashed! Check the arrows of the colours.
clips.tk_r_ei_perille: The program ended, but the battery is still far away. Add more steps.
clips.tk_r_ikuinen: The robot goes round and round and never gets there.
clips.tk_r_vihje_askeleet: Follow the yellow dots. The first arrow is
clips.tk_r_vihje_toista: Count the squares before the turn. Press the same arrow that many times. After the turn comes a new box.
clips.tk_r_vihje_jos: The white arrow shows where the path goes after the coloured square.
clips.ol_i1: This is the apple line. Apples come along the belt.
clips.ol_i2: A machine looks at every apple.
clips.ol_i3: The wrong ones drop through the hatch.
clips.ol_i4: The slicer cuts the apples, and the crate fills. A robot takes the full crate away.
clips.ol_i5: You decide what the machines let through. Press Start!
clips.ol_l1: Hi, I'm the boss! Today we sort apples by colour.
clips.ol_l2: Now we look at size. Compare the apples with a cherry, a tennis ball or a melon.
clips.ol_l3: Now we need the scale. You can't see weight, but the scale knows it.
clips.ol_l4: Now the boss wants two things at once. Put two machines on the line.
clips.ol_l5: Sometimes it's easier to say what you don't want. Try is not.

clips.ol_o_koko_iso: Big apples to the shop, bigger than a tennis ball.
clips.ol_o_koko_pieni: Small apples to the juice station, smaller than a tennis ball.
clips.ol_o_koko_kirsikka: Small apples for juice, but no cherries.
clips.ol_o_paino_pallo: Foam balls got onto the line. They look like apples but they are light. Only apples to the shop.
clips.ol_o_paino_kurpitsa: Pumpkins off! They are so heavy they jam the slicer.
clips.ol_o_paino_molemmat: Now there are foam balls and pumpkins on the line. Only apples to the shop.
clips.ol_o_ja_punainen_iso: To the shop, apples that are red and big.
clips.ol_o_ja_vihrea_pieni: For juice, apples that are green and small.
clips.ol_o_ja_punainen_aito: Red apples to the shop, but no foam balls.
clips.ol_o_ei_vihrea: All apples to the shop except the green ones.
clips.ol_o_ei_punainen: All apples for juice except the red ones.
clips.ol_o_ei_vihrea_iso: Big apples to the shop, but no green ones.
clips.ol_pomo_hyva: Good! Three clean crates. The line works just right.

clips.ol_pomo_koko: Oops! Some of the wrong size got through.
clips.ol_pomo_paino: Oops! Something too light or too heavy got through.
clips.ol_pomo_hukka: Good apples went in the bin.

clips.ol_v_koko: Compare the size. Bigger or smaller than what?
